detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Cartalax

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C12H19N3O8
  • Molecular Weight: 333.30 g/mol
  • Sequence: Ala-Glu-Asp (AED)
  • Structure Class: Synthetic tripeptide (alanine, glutamic acid, aspartic acid)
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

Cartalax is a synthetic tripeptide consisting of alanine, glutamic acid, and aspartic acid. It is provided in lyophilized powder form to ensure stability and high purity for laboratory research. Cartalax is intended exclusively for in vitro studies conducted by qualified professionals in controlled experimental environments.

Research Applications:

Cartalax is utilized in controlled laboratory research settings for applications such as:

  • Analytical evaluation of short peptide sequences under defined conditions
  • Examination of physicochemical properties, including stability and solubility profiles
  • Investigation of peptide behavior in biochemical and cell-based assay systems
  • Comparative analysis of structurally related peptide analogues in controlled experimental models
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at −20 °C until use
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2–8 °C and use promptly
  • Apply aseptic technique during handling
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white to off-white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in bacteriostatic water
Compliance Notice:

Cartalax is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
